summary: Review voting, meeting, disclosure, and accountability controls. Explore the five-day shareholder rights course and practical governance exercises.
lede: Shareholder rights and corporate accountability work focuses on documenting fair ownership, voting, meeting, and board-accountability processes. For company secretaries, governance professionals, and investor-relations teams, the training addresses how to assess rights and record how concerns are handled. Participants map ownership and voting controls, reconcile proxy instructions, review meeting and disclosure records, and prepare board reports that identify unresolved issues for decision-makers.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who administer ownership rights, oversee shareholder decisions, or report on how boards respond to investor concerns.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with shareholder meetings, company secretariat processes, corporate governance, or investor relations is expected. No coding is required.
